findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_towns, get_town, town_feed, surf_forecast, surf_cams, social_posts, blog_articles · Private data: get_town, surf_forecast · Public sink: nearby_places, town_feed, surf_forecast, social_posts · Destructive: get_town, social_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_towns, get_town, town_feed, surf_forecast, surf_cams, social_posts, blog_articles · Private data: get_town, surf_forecast · Public sink: nearby_places, town_feed, surf_forecast, social_posts · Destructive: get_town, social_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_town" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
